title: Static web app (HTML/CSS/JS)
description: Zero-dependency web app: open index.html or serve the folder. Includes a working task list with local storage, dark mode and responsive layout.
produces: Static site deployable to any host (GitHub Pages, Netlify, S3)
run: Or serve it: cd __APP_NAME__ && python3 -m http.server 8080, then open http://localhost:8080
build: No build step: deploy the folder as-is.
customize: styles.css: colour tokens live in :root at the top (light and dark)
app.js: state lives in `state`, persisted by save(); render() redraws the list
